cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Consensus Means Me
cards.instruction: Treat every partial agreement as confirmation that everyone has accepted your leadership.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You approved the blue poster. I'll record your confidence in my campaign leadership beside the colour choice.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The colour, yes. Could we work on the slogan together?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Certainly. Collaborative leadership confirmed. Send me your wording in one line; we need comparable proposals.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Let's each write one and let the volunteers choose.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Agreed. I'll delegate the choice to them. Use the same type size for both slogans, please; I want my first consultation properly run.
